desc: 开盖可见满篮子弹冰，台面场景与空白尺寸线拆解卖点，参数数值全留白
name: 拉丝钢台面便携子弹冰制冰机款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里用开盖露出满篮冰粒的干净白底主图一眼赢得点击
把机器放进真实厨房台面，用右栏三枚线性图标一秒交代核心主张
shots.textZone: right 45%: one two-line headline plus three stacked icon captions

shots.intent: 用近乎垂直的俯视微距交代出冰篮与滤梳结构，证明制冰结果而非宣称
shots.textZone: top band: one headline plus one sub-line

shots.intent: 用两枚空白规格片与无数字引出线回答选哪种冰与占多大位置，消除尺寸疑虑
shots.textZone: top-left headline band plus two chip captions at the upper right

shots.intent: 用低角度掠射微距交代一键操作的手感与布局，把易用性变成可见动作
shots.textZone: upper band: headline on a light plate plus one short caption

shots.intent: 用同款机位加硬边楔形色块与按钮形收尾，把前面积累的欲望收成一次点击
shots.textZone: wedge panel: one headline plus one rounded button shape

style.backgroundSystem: backgrounds cycle between seamless studio white #FFFFFF, a pale veined marble counter #EFEEEA and an icy blue-white field #EAF3F9, with the dark brushed fascia #2E3237 reserved for the operation macro; one hard-edged solid crimson corner wedge #E21B4F appears only on information and closing screens, never a gradient falloff and never photographic depth blur inside an information screen
style.iconSystem: thin-line pictograms only, single uniform stroke weight, drawn in #FFFFFF over the dark band or #2D3238 over light fields, one pictogram per caption slot; no filled pictograms, no gloss, nothing that reads as a certification mark, seal or badge
style.lightingSystem: cool 5600K soft key from the upper left with a broad right bounce fill, brushed steel reading as narrow vertical gradient bands instead of mirror smears, short tight contact shadow directly under the base, no warm cast, no coloured rim light and no dramatic hotspot
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool premium countertop-appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, icy blue-white field #EAF3F9, ink-grey copy #2D3238 and one crimson accent wedge #E21B4F used only as a solid hard-edged corner block; cool 5600K soft key from the upper left with a broad right bounce fill, brushed steel reading as narrow vertical gradient bands rather than mirror smears, short tight contact shadow under the base, no warm cast and no coloured rim light; backgrounds cycle between seamless white #FFFFFF, pale veined marble counter #EFEEEA and the icy blue-white field #EAF3F9, with the dark brushed fascia #2E3237 only in the operation macro, one hard-edged crimson corner wedge on information and closing screens, never a gradient falloff and never photographic depth blur inside an information screen; one modern geometric sans-serif with a bold two-line headline, stacked caption slots and hairline leader lines ending in one small solid dot, headline 32-38pt and caption 15-18pt, no English category word printed in frame; thin-line pictograms only with one uniform stroke weight, never a seal or badge; the appliance stays upright at one true scale on the same front axis with the lid at one hinge angle, and every display, indicator lamp, button face, dimension leader, callout chip and size chip stays blank with no glyph, no digit and no unit; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered readouts, no invented figures.
noDrift: no brand wordmark, English category eyebrow, store badge, promotional corner flag or QR block
no digits, units, readouts, daily-ice weight, cycle minutes, capacities or dimensions drawn on any panel, leader line, chip or screen
no colour palette changes and no warm wood, mint, rose-gold or gradient-glass surface replacing the white, marble and icy blue-white fields
no mixed fonts, no serif, no handwritten or cartoon lettering, no drop shadow behind headline text
no inconsistent key direction and no mismatched pictogram stroke weights between screens
no dense white fog, no plastic-looking opaque ice cubes and no floating product without a contact shadow
style.presentationRules: the appliance stays upright at one true scale on the same front axis with the lid hinged open at the same angle across the set, never re-scaled and never clipped; every display, indicator lamp, button face, dimension leader, callout chip and size chip stays blank with no glyph, no digit and no unit; the scoop is the only soft prop and never covers the body
style.surfaceSystem: seamless white studio sweep #FFFFFF, pale veined marble counter #EFEEEA and the moulded basket interior in light brushed grey #DDE2E6; ice is always translucent frost-white with real internal fractures, never a welded block
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif: bold two-line headline in #2D3238 on light fields or #FFFFFF on the wedge, stacked caption slots beside each icon, hairline leader lines ending in one small solid dot; headline 32-38pt, caption 15-18pt, all wording carried as placeholders and no English category word printed in frame
